test_VideoSubject_lossless_writes: test the VideoSubject class writes correct frames with lossless compression using png codec
test_VideoSubject_default_writes: test the VideoSubject class writes frames with correct shape using default compression settings
test_as_timesteps_conversion: test the _as_timesteps helper converts a list of numpy frames into dm_env restart, transition, and termination timesteps
test_get_frames_reading: test the _get_frames helper reads video frames from a file path and yields them as rgb numpy arrays
test_write_frames_to_subject: test the _write_frames_to_subject helper writes frames to a VideoSubject and returns the step number and video path
